vocabulary.meaning_en: to visit someone at their home
vocabulary.example: Can you come over on Friday?

vocabulary.meaning_en: (informal) a person's home
vocabulary.example: Let's have lunch at my place.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a home with rooms in a large building
vocabulary.example: My apartment is on the third floor.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to let someone see something
vocabulary.example: I am showing her my new room.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the underground train in Washington, D.C.
vocabulary.note_ar: في مدن أخرى يُسمّى subway أو underground.

vocabulary.example: I take the Metro to work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to leave a place; the door or way out
vocabulary.example: Exit the station and turn left.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to change direction
vocabulary.example: Turn right at the bank.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the side opposite left
vocabulary.example: The school is on the right.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the side opposite right
vocabulary.example: Turn left at the corner.

vocabulary.meaning_en: forward, in a straight line
vocabulary.example: Walk straight ahead for two minutes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to move on foot
vocabulary.example: I walk to the park every day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where buses stop and people get on
vocabulary.example: Meet me at the bus station.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not far from
vocabulary.note_ar: لا نقول near to غالبًا، بل near فقط.
vocabulary.example: My home is near the Metro.

vocabulary.meaning_en: on the other side of a street or room
vocabulary.note_ar: في الإنجليزية البريطانية يُقال غالبًا opposite.
vocabulary.example: The bank is across from the school.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small place that sells coffee and snacks
vocabulary.example: There is a coffee shop on my street.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a big shop that sells many kinds of things
vocabulary.example: I buy shoes at the department store.

vocabulary.meaning_en: large
vocabulary.example: It is a big building.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in a short time from now
vocabulary.example: The bus is coming soon.

vocabulary.meaning_en: after that; next
vocabulary.example: Turn left, then walk straight.

vocabulary.meaning_en: used to ask about one thing from a group
vocabulary.example: Which bus goes to the airport?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to talk to someone on the phone
vocabulary.example: My friend is calling me.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in this place, near me
vocabulary.example: I'm over here, by the door!

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person you like and know well
vocabulary.example: My friend is coming to my home today.

fine_lines.title: near vs across from
fine_lines.explanation_ar: near تعني قريبًا من الشيء في أي اتجاه. across from تعني في الجهة المقابلة تمامًا، وغالبًا بينهما شارع.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Near means close to something, on any side. Across from means on the other side, often with a street between.

examples.sentence: My house is near the park.
The pharmacy is across from the bank.

fine_lines.title: right vs left vs straight ahead
fine_lines.explanation_ar: turn right = انعطف يمينًا، turn left = انعطف يسارًا، go straight ahead = امشِ إلى الأمام دون انعطاف. ملاحظة: right لها معنى آخر أيضًا: صحيح.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Turn right, turn left, or go straight ahead (don't turn). Note: right can also mean correct.

examples.sentence: The door is on your left.
Go straight ahead to the station.

expressions.example: Where is your apartment? Is it near here?

expressions.phrase: Exit the Metro and turn right.
expressions.meaning_en: Leave the train station, then go right.
expressions.example: Exit the Metro and turn right at the corner.
Walk straight ahead and you will see it.

expressions.phrase: My apartment is near a coffee shop.
expressions.meaning_en: My home is close to a coffee shop.
expressions.example: My apartment is near a big park.

expressions.meaning_en: Goodbye; we will meet very soon.
expressions.example: I'm coming now. See you soon!

expressions.meaning_en: Asking about one place from many.
expressions.example: There are two banks here. Which bank?

expressions.meaning_en: I can see the place now.
expressions.example: The red building? Ah, I see it!

expressions.meaning_en: Come to this place; I am here.
expressions.example: Over here! I'm by the door!

expressions.phrase: I love having my friends over.
expressions.meaning_ar: أحب أن يزورني أصدقائي في بيتي.
expressions.meaning_en: I like it when friends visit my home.
expressions.example: I love having my family over on Fridays.

grammar.title: Giving directions with imperatives
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) لإعطاء الاتجاهات نستخدم صيغة الأمر: الفعل في أول الجملة بدون فاعل.
٢) Turn left. / Walk straight ahead. / Exit the Metro.
٣) نربط الخطوات بـ and و then: Turn right, then turn left.
٤) للنفي: Don't + فعل: Don't turn here.
grammar.explanation_en:
1) To give directions, use the imperative: start with the verb, no subject.
2) Turn left. / Walk straight ahead. / Exit the Metro.
3) Join steps with and and then: Turn right, then turn left.
4) Negative: Don't + verb: Don't turn here.
examples: Exit the station and turn left.
Walk straight ahead, then turn right.

grammar.title: Present continuous for plans and actions now
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) نستخدم am / is / are + فعل مع ing لشيء يحدث الآن: I am showing her my apartment.
٢) ونستخدمه أيضًا لخطة قريبة: My friend is coming over today.
grammar.explanation_en:
1) am / is / are + verb-ing for something happening now: I am showing her my apartment.
2) We also use it for a near plan: My friend is coming over today.
examples: Ashley is coming to my apartment.
I'm walking to the station now.
We are having lunch at my place today.

questions.question: "Come over to my place" means:
questions.explanation_ar: come over = يزور، و my place = بيتي.
questions.explanation_en: Come over = visit; my place = my home.

questions.question: "Go straight ahead" means:
questions.explanation_ar: straight ahead تعني إلى الأمام مباشرة.
questions.explanation_en: Straight ahead means forward, without turning.

questions.question: The bank is on one side of the street. The school is on the other side. The bank is ___ the school.
questions.explanation_ar: across from تعني في الجهة المقابلة.
questions.explanation_en: Across from means on the other side.

questions.question: "There are three coffee shops." "___ coffee shop?"
questions.explanation_en: We use which to choose one from a group.

questions.question: What is a department store?
choices: a big shop that sells many things
questions.explanation_ar: department store متجر كبير يبيع أشياء كثيرة.
questions.explanation_en: A department store is a big shop with many kinds of things.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: My friend is come over today.
My friend are coming over today.
My friend is coming over today.
questions.explanation_en: Use is + coming with a singular subject.

questions.question: Which word has a silent letter?
questions.explanation_ar: حرف l في walk لا يُنطق.
questions.explanation_en: The l in walk is silent.
